text:
O voice, only voice: all the hollow of the sea,
all the hollow of the sea would not be enough,
all the hollow of the sky,
the whole cavity of beauty
would not be enough to contain you;
and though humanity fell silent and this world sank,
O majesty, you would never,
you would never cease to be everywhere,
for you have time and being to spare, only voice;
for you are and are not, and are almost my God,
and almost my father when I am at my darkest.

translation.title: O Voice, Only Voice: All the Hollow of the Sea...
